Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 demonstrates bilateral alveolar-interstitial opacities that are more prominent in the lower lung zones, while Figure 4 reveals a dramatic progression to dense, diffuse bilateral consolidations. This rapid worsening of airspace disease is highly characteristic of massive alveolar hemorrhage or severe acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), distinguishing it from resolving infections or simple heart failure.
